articles.title: IBM BOB MAKES WORKFLOWS REVIEWABLE, TESTABLE AND SCALABLE
articles.summary:
The value of IBM Bob, an AI development partner, isn't simply that it writes code. It also helps turn messy discovery work into artifacts engineers can review, test and reuse. For developers, Bob helps reduce discovery work time by analyzing systems, generating work that fits team conventions and supporting the software development lifecycle.

CrushBank developers used IBM Bob to reason through architecture, move into implementation and inspected generated changes without leaving the workflow. Bob helped identify patterns, build ingestion paths and create solutions while keeping developers in control through code reviews, sensitive data scanning, test harnesses and human peer review.

ANTHROPIC REPORTEDLY SIGNED A $10B CLOUD DEAL WITH VOLTA
articles.summary: Anthropic reportedly agreed to buy six years of cloud capacity from AI infrastructure startup Volta. The planned 133-megawatt Norway data center would be developed with Bitdeer and powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems.

articles.title: A UNIFIED API FOR AI MODEL ROUTING
articles.summary: Model routing on the Google Cloud API Gateway is now available in public preview. The API gateway provides a lightweight, serverless ingress layer that accepts OpenAI-compatible requests and dynamically routes them to Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI OSS-GPT. It can be used standalone for simple rate limiting and token tracking or paired seamlessly with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. This article contains a step-by-step guide on how to configure router logic.

articles.title: CLOUDFLARE INTRODUCED PROGRAMMABLE WALLETS FOR AI AGENTS
articles.summary: Cloudflare Wallets is a system designed to give AI agents stable identities and controlled access to payments for APIs, MCP tools, and online content. Virtual Wallets will support spending limits, allow lists, and transaction caps for safer agentic commerce.

articles.title: UNPACKING CHATGPT WORK: THE AGENT FOR A BILLION USERS
articles.summary: ChatGPT Work is OpenAI's agent product for knowledge work. Its current form is an amalgamation of ChatGPT, the Codex app, the Codex harness, the original Codex cloud agent, ChatGPT agent, Atlas, OpenClaw, and more. This article decodes the complex product lineup and explains what Work is, where it fits in OpenAI's lineup, the many interesting choices in its design, the tensions underneath, and where the product is likely headed. OpenAI plans to merge Chat and Work, so Work is really a preview for how ChatGPT's billions of users will soon use the app.

articles.title: WHAT CODEX ACTUALLY SENDS TO THE MODEL
articles.summary: A developer recorded the requests Codex generated for a 16-character prompt by pointing it at a custom local server. They measured what changed as it loaded instructions, exposed tools, read files, ran commands, received images, and compacted its history. The experiment did not call an external model. This post details the findings from the experiment.

articles.title: BLACK DUCK: AI-DRIVEN EXPLOITS ARE HERE. ARE YOU READY?
articles.summary: The exploit window is collapsing. AI turns newly disclosed vulnerabilities into working attacks in hours, not weeks. BLACK DUCK POLARIS™ PLATFORM and SIGNAL™ help organizations become Mythos Ready with intelligent prioritization, automated workflows, and faster remediation of exploitable risk.

articles.title: BLACK DUCK CAN HELP.
INTRODUCING SHIELDSTRAL
articles.summary: Shieldstral features a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier that outperforms models up to 7x its size. It accepts plain-language policies at inference time, unifying text and image safety evaluation without retraining. Shieldstral delivers calibrated safety scores across diverse benchmarks while running efficiently on a single 16GB NVIDIA GPU. It is a step toward moderation that adapts to context instead of forcing every product through one frozen taxonomy.

articles.title: NVIDIA RELEASED ALPAMAYO 2
articles.summary: NVIDIA has released Alpamayo 2 Super under a commercial license for robotaxis and autonomous vehicles. The reasoning model was designed to handle rare driving scenarios with inspectable decisions and broad multitask capabilities.

articles.title: INTRODUCING KIRO CREW
articles.summary: Kiro Crew is a persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session. It can run locally or remotely on personal hardware. Kiro Crew allows developers to start work from within a desktop app, web dashboard, or CLI, and continue the same work through connection tools like Slack and Discord. It can run multistep tasks and recurring jobs on a schedule and also monitor systems until something needs attention.

articles.title: DIFFUSIONGEMMA TECHNICAL REPORT
articles.summary: DiffusionGemma adapted Gemma 4 into a discrete diffusion model that refined 256-token blocks in parallel, reaching roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100.

articles.title: THE COMPUTER USE VERIFICATION SKILL THAT EVERY AGENT NEEDS
articles.summary: Computer-use verification lets coding agents reproduce bugs, validate implementations against specs, and attach screenshots or videos to pull requests. Integrated into triage, implementation, and review workflows, cloud-based subagents reduce human review burden and enable iterative self-debugging.

articles.title: SPACEX SAYS SPENDING SPREE IS SUPERCHARGING AI REVENUES
articles.summary: SpaceX's capital expenditures hit $18.4 billion in the most recent quarter. The bulk of that figure is tied to the company's ongoing AI build-out. The company is plowing money into terrestrial computing infrastructure, signing AI deals, and working toward launching orbital data centers. SpaceX is on track to have $100 billion in annualized recurring revenue by December, most of it coming from data center deals.

articles.title: MIXTURE-OF-KITTENS: OUR OPEN-SOURCE MOE MEGAKERNEL FOR NVL72S
articles.summary: Cursor's Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK) is an open-source optimized Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) megakernel that improves efficiency on NVL72s GPUs, which significantly boosts performance for models like Composer by addressing computation and communication bottlenecks.

articles.title: LFM2.5-2.6B: DEPLOY AGENTS EVERYWHERE
articles.summary: LFM2.5-2.6B, a 2.6B parameter on-device agentic model, enables free inference, low latency, and robust privacy by running locally on hardware like phones or CPUs.
